title: avd-assess-method/v1: the rules avd-assess's method runs (method.json)
description: Contract C20. The machine-readable part of avd-assess's gap files: where each fact comes from (collection), declarative checks of published claims against registered facts (assessment), what each C14 decision needs (readiness) and how outcomes roll up (scoring). No code: a check is a JSON pointer, a filter and an expectation. avd-current-state runs a byte-identical copy pinned by commit; the brain checks it with Test-AssessMethod.

deprecated.description: Marks an ID that a later major release may remove (docs/distribution-spec.md section 6): the release that first carried the mark and the ID that replaces it, if any. Readers keep using a deprecated ID until it is gone.

remediation.description: What would make a non-pass outcome pass, as a hint for the remediation plan (C24). lz-parameter: an avd-landing-zone parameter and the public value it should take; lz-setting: something the landing zone always applies, so a redeploy from it fixes the finding; manual: outside what a landing zone redeploy fixes, with a code, never free text (rebuild-hosts: hosts the landing zone deploys have it, existing hosts must be replaced).

publicValue.description: A public value only: a SKU, a count, a boolean, a region. Never a name, prefix or address: a string starts with a letter and holds only letters, digits and underscores, so an address, a CIDR prefix or a hyphenated resource name can't pass.

pointer.description: JSON pointer into a C11 snapshot or a C19 intake; * is every array item

version.description: Bumped on any change to a check, a readiness rule or the scoring; C21 reports pin it

landingZoneCommit.description: Optional: the avd-landing-zone commit whose bicep/main.bicep the checks' lz-parameter and lz-setting hints were read from

factRegister.description: The C15 register version the method's fact IDs come from

collection.description: Where each fact comes from, a gap file in avd-assess. Each row cites the reference that documents the property; only the join is ours.

table.description: Resource Graph table (Resources, DesktopVirtualizationResources, PolicyResources) or Insights table

type.description: ARM resource type the row reads, for example microsoft.desktopvirtualization/hostpools

rule.description: For each subject at 'each' that matches 'where', every 'expect' test must hold. A missing property makes that subject unknown, never a failure.

onFail.description: warn: a trade-off to review, not a defect

facts.description: Facts that decide it; for needs-measurement, the forensic facts a measurement would supply

scoring.description: gap:scoring, a research hypothesis: a pillar's score is the passing severity weight over the assessed weight, warn counting warnFactor; coverage (checks not unknown over all checks) is always shown beside it; no overall number.

overall.description: Version 1 has no single overall number (the owner's call to change)
